financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM program sales of 234,449 shares through March 21, 2024 (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: the Company has sold an aggregate of 234,449 shares of common stock in ATM offerings under the November 2023 Shelf and pursuant to the ATM Agreement for aggregate gross proceeds of $15.3 million.
